h:
干净、轻便且适合初学者的 ComfyUI 工作流程，专为无缝风格转换、角色转换和草图到照片生成而设计，由FLUX.2 克莱因 9B.

无论您是想将粗略的线条草图变成逼真的图片，还是将真实照片转换为动漫、油画或梵高油画，此工作流程都可以轻松处理。

o.en:
A clean, light, and beginner-friendly ComfyUI workflow designed for seamless style transfers, character transformations, and sketch-to-photo generations powered byFLUX.2 Klein 9B.

Whether you want to turn a rough lineart sketch into a photorealistic picture or transform a real photo into an anime, oil painting, or Van Gogh Oil Painting, this workflow handles it effortlessly.
